# QC

## cell-line QC

```{r}
library(ggridges)


len_plot <- nanopore_len %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "Xenograft")) %>%
  filter(sample %in% cell_line) %>%
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none",
       strip.text.y = element_blank())+
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette)+
  xlab("Read Length (bp)")

qscore <- pdx11 %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "Xenograft")) %>%
  # filter(sample %in% cell_line) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = mean_qscore_template, sample, fill = sample_type))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text.x = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none")+
  ylab("Mean Base Quality Score")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette)
  

coverage_plot <-coverage %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(coverage = round(sum(mean *bases / sum(bases)), 0)) %>%
  ungroup()  %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "Xenograft")) %>%
  filter(sample %in% cell_line) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = coverage, fill = sample_type))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom")+
  theme_bw()+
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0(coverage, "x")), vjust=0)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text.x = element_blank(),
       axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none",
       axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  ylab("Averaged Depth")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette, "Sample")
  

merged_plot <- ggarrange(len_plot,ggarrange(coverage_plot+
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.title.x = element_blank()), qscore, nrow = 2, heights = c(0.3, 0.7), align= "v"), common.legend = T, legend = "bottom")
ggsave(plot = merged_plot, filename = "plots/nanopore_cell_line_qc.png",  width = 210, height = 297/1.5, units = "mm")
```

## Methylation correlation

```{r}
# correlation to methylation array
methylation_array <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/GSK_treated_OvCa/output/batch2_beta_post_filt.tsv") %>%
  dplyr::select(CpG, OVCAR8_LP_A6_30 = OVCAR8.A6.meth_DMSO, WEHI_CS62 = `62_DMSO2`) %>%
  left_join(fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/GSK_treated_OvCa/output/batch1_beta_post_filt.tsv") %>%
              dplyr::select(CpG, OVCAR8= OVCAR8_DMSO))
array_annotation <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/GSK_treated_OvCa/supporting/EPIC-8v2-0_A1.csv", header =T, skip ="IlmnID")

methylation_array <- methylation_array %>%
  left_join(array_annotation%>%
              dplyr::select(CpG = IlmnID,CHR, MAPINFO )) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "WEHI_CS62"), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "beta" )

lr_epiv2 <- methylation_array %>%
  left_join(lr_cell_line %>%
              filter(mod_type == "m") %>%
              mutate(m_h = (Nother_mod+Nmod)/Nvalid_cov) %>%
              dplyr::select(CHR = chrom, MAPINFO = end, fraction_mod,m_h, Sample))


lr_epiv2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = beta, y = m_h))+
  geom_bin2d(bins = 60)+
  stat_cor(label.y = 1.1) +
  stat_regline_equation(label.y = 1.05)+scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", trans = "log2")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  xlab("%5mC +%5hmC per CpG")+
  ylab("EPIC V2 beta")+
  facet_wrap(~Sample)
ggsave("plots/array_lr_corr.pdf", units = "mm", width = 210*1.5, height = 297/3*1.5 )


#inter-sample correlation

library(GGally)
ggcorr(lr_cell_line %>%
              filter(mod_type == "m") %>%
         mutate(CpG = paste(chrom, start, sep ="_")) %>%
         dplyr::select(CpG, Sample, fraction_mod) %>%
         pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = fraction_mod) %>%
         column_to_rownames("CpG") %>%
         drop_na(), label = TRUE, label_round = 2,limits = c(0, 1), midpoint = 0.5, legend.position = "right", hjust = 0.75, layout.exp = 1)

ggsave("plots/lr_intersample_corr.pdf", units = "mm", width = 210*1.5, height = 297/3*1.5 )
```

# Global analysis

##HRD vs HRP\

### global methylation diff

```{r}
global_filtered <- lr_cell_line %>%
  filter(mod_type == 'm', Nvalid_cov >= 10,Nvalid_cov <= 100, chrom %in% paste0("chr", seq(1,22))) %>%
  mutate(site = paste(chrom, start, end , sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(site, fraction_mod, Sample) %>%
  dt_pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = fraction_mod) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  dt_pivot_longer(cols = c(OVCAR8, OVCAR8_LP_A6_30, UWB1, UWB1_BRCA1, WEHI_CS62), values_to = "fraction_mod", names_to = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(HR = if_else(Sample %in% c("OVCAR8", "UWB1_BRCA1"), "HRP", "HRD"))


global_filtered$HR <- ordered(global_filtered$HR, levels = c("HRP", "HRD"))


```

```{r}
global_filtered %>%
  group_by(Sample)%>%
  mutate(Sample = if_else(Sample == "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "OVCAR8_A6_meth", Sample),
          Sample =  factor(Sample, levels = c("OVCAR8_A6_meth", "OVCAR8", "UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1", "WEHI_CS62"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y = fraction_mod, color = HR))+
  geom_violin()+
  stat_summary(fun = "median",
               geom = "crossbar", 
               color = "black",
               width = 0.1)+
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("OVCAR8_A6_meth","OVCAR8"), c("UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1")),method = "wilcox")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("HRD" = "#196B24", "HRP"= "#E97132"))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave("plots/cell_line_global_comparison.pdf", height =5, width = 7)
```

### HRR dmp validation in ICGC

```{r}
library(readxl)

icgc_purity <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/HRDmethyl_public/data/processed/ICGC_OV_purity.csv")
icgc_ov <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/HRDmethyl_public/data/processed/methylation/ICGC_OV_meth_norm_beta.csv", check.names = F) %>%
  gather(-V1, key = "array_name", value = "beta")

icgc_ov_pvalue <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/HRDmethyl_public/data/processed/methylation/ICGC_OV_beta_pvalue.csv")

icgc_pd <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/HRDmethyl_public/data/raw/20220505_ICGC_OV_meth/IDAT/ICGC_OV_pd.csv") %>%
  mutate(array_name = paste(Sample_Name, Sentrix_ID,Sentrix_Position, sep = "_")) %>%
  left_join(icgc_ov) %>%
  mutate(donorLabel = gsub("_", "-", substr(Sample.ID, 1, 8))) %>%
  left_join(icgc_ov_pvalue %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample_Name = V1, pvalue = V2)) %>%
  group_by(donorLabel, Tissue_type, V1) %>%
  filter(pvalue == min(pvalue)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(donorLabel, Tissue_type, Sample.ID, probeID = V1, beta)  %>%
  mutate(Tissue_type = gsub("(?<=.)([A-Z])", " \\1",
                            gsub("^[0-9]+", "", Tissue_type), perl = TRUE))


icgc_pd <- icgc_pd %>%
  right_join(icgc_purity %>%
               mutate(V1 = gsub("-", "_", V1) ) %>%
               dplyr::select(Sample.ID = V1, purity = V2))

sample_label <- read_excel("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/HRDmethyl_public/data/supporting/nature14410-Supplementary Table 13.xlsx",sheet = 2, skip = 2) %>%
  dplyr::select(donorLabel = SampleID, subtype = `HRD/CCNE1/WT Group`)

  mutate(SampleID = substr( `Study ID`, 1, 8), type = "Germline") %>%
  dplyr::select(donorLabel = SampleID, Response, Gene = Genea, type),
  read_excel("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/HRDmethyl_public/data/supporting/nature14410-Supplementary_Table_4.xlsx",sheet = 2, skip = 1) %>%
  mutate(SampleID = substr(`Study ID`,1, 8), type = "Somatic") %>%
  dplyr::select(donorLabel = SampleID, Response, Gene = Genea, type))

annotation <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/HRDmethyl_public/data/supporting/HM450.hg38.manifest.gencode.v36.tsv.gz")

icgc_available <- icgc_pd %>%
  left_join(annotation %>%
              dplyr::select(chr_probe = CpG_chrm, start_probe = CpG_beg, probeID)) %>%
  right_join(hrd_dmp %>%
               dplyr::select(chr, end), by = join_by(chr_probe == chr, start_probe  ==end))%>%
  left_join(sample_label) %>%
  left_join(sample_mut)


icgc_available %>%
  left_join(sample_label) %>%

              filter(type == "Somatic")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(probeID), !is.na(subtype),( Response == "Sensitive" & subtype =="HRD" & Tissue_type =="Primary Tumour")| (subtype == "WT")) %>%
  filter(purity >= 0.7) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = beta, x = subtype, color = Response))+
```

### statistic comparison per base

```{r}

blacklist <- fread("ref/hg38-blacklist.v2.bed") %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("chrom", "annotation_start", "annotation_end", "type"))
mere_region <- rbind(fread("ref/hg38_gap.tsv") %>%
  filter(type == "Telomere") %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, annotation_start = chromStart, annotation_end = chromEnd, type) ,
fread("ref/hg38_centromere.tsv") %>%
  mutate(type = "Centromere") %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, annotation_start = chromStart, annotation_end = chromEnd, type) )


promoter <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/ref/EDPnew_20240409.bed")
gene_body <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/GSK_treated_OvCa/supporting/MANE.GRCh38.v1.3.ensembl_genomic_transcript.gtf") %>%
  dplyr::select(CHR =V1, chromStart = V4, chromEnd = V5)

               dplyr::select(chrom = V1, chromStart = V2, chromEnd = V3)
cgi <- rbind(cgi%>% mutate(cgi = "island"),
             cgi%>% mutate(chromStart =chromStart -2000, chromEnd =chromEnd -2000, cgi = "shore"),
             cgi%>% mutate(chromStart =chromStart +2000, chromEnd =chromEnd +2000, cgi = "shore"),
             cgi%>% mutate(chromStart =chromStart -4000, chromEnd =chromEnd -4000, cgi = "shelf"),
             cgi%>% mutate(chromStart =chromStart +4000, chromEnd =chromEnd +4000, cgi = "shelf"))

dmp_annot <-as(dmp_cell_line,"data.frame") %>%
  left_join(hrd_dmp_pdx %>%
              mutate(diff = "PDX_dmp") %>%
              dplyr::select(chr, start, diff))%>%
  mutate(diff = case_when(diff == "PDX_dmp" ~ "DMP(PDX)",
                          qvalue < 0.05 &  abs(meth.diff) > 25 ~ "DMP(Cell-line only)",
                          TRUE ~ "Non-DMP"),
         diff = factor(diff, levels = c("DMP(PDX)", "DMP(Cell-line only)", "Non-DMP")),
    end = end +1) %>%
  left_join(rbind(blacklist, mere_region), by = join_by( chr == chrom, start >= annotation_start, end <= annotation_end )) %>%
  mutate(type = if_else(is.na(type), "Others", type))

dmp_annot  <- dmp_annot %>%
  left_join(promoter %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom = `#chrom`, chromStart, chromEnd, name), by = join_by( chr == chrom, start>= chromStart, end <= chromEnd)) %>%
  mutate(genomic_gene_context = if_else(!is.na(name), "Promoter", NA)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(name, chromStart, chromEnd)) %>%
    left_join(gene_body, by = join_by( chr== CHR, start>= chromStart,  end <= chromEnd)) %>%
  mutate(genomic_gene_context = if_else(!is.na(chromStart) & is.na(genomic_gene_context), "Gene Body", genomic_gene_context)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(chromStart, chromEnd))  %>%
  mutate(genomic_gene_context = if_else(is.na(genomic_gene_context), "Intergenic", genomic_gene_context)) %>%
  distinct()


dmp_annot %>%
  dplyr::select(chr, start, end, type =diff, genomic_gene_context) %>%
   group_by(type, genomic_gene_context) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  mutate(prop = n/sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = type, fill = genomic_gene_context, y = prop))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, position = "fill")+
   geom_text(aes(label=n),position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5))+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Promoter"= "#7d4f50", "Gene Body" = "#cc8b86", "Intergenic" ="#f9eae1" ), "Gene Context")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent)+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  xlab("Differential Methylation HRD vs HRP")+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=2,byrow=TRUE))
  
ggsave("plots/isogenic_CpGs_enrichment_bar.pdf", height =5, width = 4)
```

### overlapped gene

```{r}
mane_file <- fread("ref/MANE.GRCh38.v1.3.ensembl_genomic_clean.tsv", sep = "\t", header = F, fill=TRUE) 
mane_gene_coord <- mane_file %>%
  filter(V3 == "gene") %>%
  mutate(gene_name = gsub("gene_name=", "", V12)) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom = V1, gene_start = V4, gene_end = V5, gene_name)

hrd_dmp_pdx %>%
  left_join(mane_gene_coord, by = join_by(chr == chrom, start >= gene_start, end<= gene_end)) %>%
  mutate(diff_dir = if_else(meth.diff >0, "+", "-")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_name)) %>%
  group_by(diff_dir, gene_name) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  arrange(-n)
```

## 5hmc hrd vs hrp

```{r}

library(methylKit)
lr_cell_line_5hmc  %>%
  filter(chrom %in% paste0("chr", seq(1,22))) %>%
  mutate(chrBase = paste(chrom, start, sep = "."),
         strand = ".",
         freqT = Nvalid_cov - Nmod) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrBase, chr = chrom,  base = start, strand, coverage = Nvalid_cov, freqC = Nmod, freqT, Sample) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
group_walk(~ write_tsv(.x, paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/",.y$Sample, "amp_style_5hmC.txt")), .keep = T)
reload <- methRead(list("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/OVCAR8amp_style_5hmC.txt",
                        "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/OVCAR8_LP_A6_30amp_style_5hmC.txt",
                        "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/UWB1amp_style_5hmC.txt" ,
                        "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/UWB1_BRCA1amp_style_5hmC.txt"),
                   sample.id = list("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8_A6_meth", "UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1"),
                   assembly = "hg38",
                   treatment = c(0, 1, 1, 0 ),
                   context="CpG")


filtered_reload <- filterByCoverage(reload, lo.count =5, hi.count = 100)
meth = unite(filtered_reload, destrand = F)
dmp_cell_line <- calculateDiffMeth(meth, mc.cores = 12)

saveRDS(dmp_cell_line, file = "cell_line_HRD_DMP_5hmc.RDS")

dmp_cell_line  <- readRDS("cell_line_HRD_DMP_5hmc.RDS")


hrd_dmp <- data.frame(getMethylDiff(dmp_cell_line, qvalue = 0.05, diff = 25))

hrd_dmp %>%
  summarise(increase = sum(meth.diff >0),
            decrease = sum(meth.diff < 0))

library("karyoploteR")

changedCpGgrange <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(hrd_dmp %>%
                                               filter(chr %in% paste0("chr", seq(1,22))) %>%
                                               mutate(meth.diff= meth.diff /100,
                                                      diff_color = if_else(meth.diff <=0, "blue", "red" )) %>%
    dplyr::select(CHR =chr, start ,end, meth.diff,diff_color) , keep.extra.columns = T, ignore.strand = T, start.field = "start", end.field = "end")
pdf("plots/DMP_HRD_distribution.pdf", height = 6, width = 5)
kp <- plotKaryotype(plot.type = 2, genome = "hg38", chromosomes = paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))
kpPoints(kp,data = changedCpGgrange, y =changedCpGgrange@elementMetadata@listData$meth.diff,col = changedCpGgrange@elementMetadata@listData$diff_color ,  cex = 0.2)
legend(x = "bottomright", fill = c("blue", "red"), legend = c("low in HRD", "high in HRD"))
dev.off()
```
